name: Aboshan
title: The Cephalid Emperor
summary: A ruler whose attempt to realize his desires through the Mirari caused a devastating flood.
biography: Aboshan ruled the cephalid empire during the crisis that followed the Mirari's discovery on Otaria.
When he obtained the Mirari, his wish for dominion over the sea was magnified into catastrophic magic that flooded great stretches of the continent and devastated his capital.
His destruction demonstrates that a ruler's ambition was no more immune to the Mirari than the desires of a gladiator or a dementia caster.

featuredCard.name: Aboshan, Cephalid Emperor
featuredCard.significance: An original Odyssey portrait of the emperor whose use of the Mirari caused disaster.
